insight: Founded in September 2024; raised a $4.35M seed round in 2025 to build real-time AI-avatar technology.
name: Pickle
tagline: A real-time AI clone of you that joins video calls as a virtual camera.
description: Pickle is a macOS app that creates a hyper-realistic AI avatar of you for video calls. After a face scan and a short training video, your 'AI Self' lip-syncs to your voice in real time and appears as a selectable 'Pickle Camera' in any video app. It lets you be present on camera-on calls without sitting in front of the webcam.

modelSupport.notes: Proprietary real-time avatar model trained from a short user video.

edge: Renders a real-time, voice-driven lip-synced clone as a virtual camera, so you join any call looking present without being on camera.
pros: Works as a virtual cam in any app
cons: Realism can break under fast motion
